rules.grade_rule: clamp(ceil(accepted health loss / divisor), 1, 3); zero accepted loss creates no wound
rules.repeated_hit_rule: same kind and body part: min(3,max(old grade,hit grade)+(accepted loss>=2 ? 1 : 0))
rules.capacity_rule: At eight wounds, current insertWound strengthens the nearest existing wound by one; it does not create a ninth.
rules.hot_tool_exception: Current hot heated_awl forces at least grade 2; the removed local-burn art path is not exported.
rules.core_rule: A supported grade-three mechanical opening, current health/max health <= threshold, and a fitted path to the actual central filling; never an independent random variant.

basis: 10-health example with supported blade/blunt/bite/blast contact, no armor assumptions, no terminal destruction or core damage; actual fitted opening required.
